title: R&SVP – Hio Ridge | Barn wedding venue, Bridgton, Maine
description: Our barn wedding venue in Bridgton, Maine pairs vows facing Pleasant Mountain with dinner under 1820 beams. Up to 135 guests. Sundays, May through October.

hero.alt: Inside the barn at Hio Ridge in the evening: the timber frame, chandeliers, and the loft rail
hero.headline: Vows facing Pleasant Mountain. *Dinner under the beams.*
hero.line: A barn wedding venue on our family farm in Bridgton, Maine

statement.quote: There's something about these 1820 beams you have to see in person.

intro.heading: Your first meal as a married couple.
body: Take your seats at the head table, with the field beyond the open French doors. The people who watched you say your vows are here for dinner, too. We have space for your ceremony and reception on the same farm.

We welcome up to 135 guests, with separate rooms for getting ready and a prep kitchen for your caterer. Tables and chairs come with the rental. We host weddings without alcohol, on Sundays and weekdays from May through October.
intro.alt: The head table set at the open French doors, the field beyond

paths.title: Your walk down the aisle
paths.body: Say your vows facing Pleasant Mountain. Your guests sit on benches we made from the barn's old floorboards.
paths.alt: Benches in the field and the farmhouse in evening light

paths.title: Dinner beneath the beams
paths.body: Choose long tables or rounds for the meal you'll share. We include tables and chairs. Susan can talk through the dining spaces with you.
paths.alt: Inside the barn in the evening, chandeliers and the loft rail

paths.title: Your dress, ready in the ell
paths.body: Get ready with your wedding party beside you. Our bridal room and separate groom's room are in the ell beside the barn.
paths.alt: A wedding dress on the hook in the bridal room

setting.heading: Say your vows *with October on the mountain.*
setting.body: Autumn brings color to the trees beyond our ceremony field. We host weddings from May through October. Come see the view of Pleasant Mountain as you consider a season.
setting.alt: The barn across the lawn in early October, trees turning along the tree line

evening.heading: Step out into the evening.
evening.body: Sit beside each other in the stone seating circle or catch up with family on the patio. String lights hang outside the barn.
evening.alt: The barn at night, windows lit, French doors open onto the patio

proof.title: Walk through the barn
proof.body: A private tour lets you see the rooms and ceremony field before choosing a date. Contact Susan to arrange a visit.

proof.title: Plan around your budget
proof.body: Tables and chairs are included. Ask for our pricing brochure so you can compare the rental with the rest of your wedding plans.

proof.title: Meet your hosts
proof.body: We're Susan and Richard. We restored the family barn, and we're on site at events.

story_teaser.heading: The boards we saved. *The farm we share.*
story_teaser.body: Susan's family has kept this farm since 1941. When we restored the barn, we kept its old boards and added the house windows. Now we welcome other families to celebrate here.
story_teaser.alt: Susan and Richard Voth at the barn door

closing.heading: Stand in the field. *Look toward the mountain.*
closing.body: No date yet? Come for a private tour. Contact Susan to schedule a visit or ask for our pricing brochure.

paths_heading: Before the vows. After the ceremony.
